'''Julept''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] who often visited [[Farrimmer Cafe]] to swap stories and sell scraps of technology he had acquired previously. He would usually regal other patrons with a story of a [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] companion who conviced him to travel to [[Byss/Legends|Byss]] to [[Death/Legends|kill]] both [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] and the [[Palpatine/Legends|Emperor]], though he would always admit, in the end, that it was a joke.<ref name="FC">{{JournalCite|11|The Farrimmer Cafe}}</ref>
